candidates.change_summary: Change supportsInterface to only check for IAccessControl (removing ERC165 check), returning true only for IAccessControl interface id.
Change supportsInterface to always return false (no interface supported).
Change supportsInterface to always return true (advertise support for any interface id).
Invert original logic: return true only if interfaceId is not IERC165 and not IAccessControl (negation of original).
Change hasRole to return the inverse of the stored membership mapping (negate the boolean result).
Change hasRole to always return true (ignores stored membership).
Change hasRole to always return false (ignores stored membership).
Change hasRole to return membership of the zero address instead of the provided account (uses role mapping at address(0)).
Change hasRole to treat any account equal to contract address as having role (returns true for address(this), otherwise uses stored mapping).
